rounds.text: Caprihans India Ltd trades at a negative P/E of -2.9x compared to a sector benchmark of 23.88x, reflecting severe underlying unprofitability rather than a straightforward bargain [E5]. This lack of earnings power is reinforced by a negative ROA of -3.97% and a deeply negative ROE of -11.64%, both trailing their respective sector benchmarks of 4.99% and 10.27% by wide margins [E7, E8]. Top-line deterioration compounds these fundamental weaknesses, as demonstrated by a 3-year compounded sales growth of -9% and a trailing twelve months sales contraction of -5% [E15, E16]. Furthermore, shareholders receive zero income protection during this downturn, with the dividend yield sitting at a flat 0.00% [E3]. Conceded: the company displays a low price-to-book ratio of 0.29x alongside a 5-year compounded sales growth rate of 19% [E1, E14].
